messages:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service deploy (fanout) to production — canary window
deploy-bot: Services: runtime@v2.14.1 (abc1234), api@v1.40.0 (def5678), console@v0.9.13 (9ab8c7d)
deploy-bot: Canary targets: 5% runtime, 2% api, 10% console. Change window 15m. :rocket:
release-manager: ack, release notes published https://redwood/release/2026-03-20/rel-319
anya: hold — there's an in-flight infra migration to k8s nodepool-7, can we delay console until after migration finishes?
micah: migration is green, finished 3m ago. go for deploy. :+1:
josh: quick reminder: console has recent DB index hotfix — if it alerts pin to 9ab8c7c instead of 9ab8c7d
deploy-bot: runtime deploy started on host group rg-runtime-prod-1
deploy-bot: api deploy started on host group rg-api-prod-2
deploy-bot: console deploy started on host group rg-console-prod-1
deploy-bot: runtime canary instances up (3/3). readiness: OK. latency p50 45ms, errors 0.2%
marina: watching logs for any NPE traces from the new runtime attn @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: got it — alerting rules set to aggressive for this window
deploy-bot: api canary: rollout 30% of traffic to new revision — healthchecks passing, 200 OK rate 99.6%
deploy-bot: console canary: rollout 10% — failing frontend build on 1 node: webpack OOM, pulling logs
deploy-bot: console node-5 log excerpt:
```
FATAL: JavaScript heap out of memory
at some-webpack-plugin (build.js:1234)
```
marina: hm, that looks like build-time OOM after deploy — is this runtime or image issue?
anya: console image matches registry tag 9ab8c7d, build had higher mem usage in staging too
josh: recommendation: pin console to previous tag 9ab8c7c for canary while we investigate. want automatic rollback?
release-manager: agree with pin, keep runtime/api going.
deploy-bot: pinning console canary to 9ab8c7c and aborting rollout to new console tag 9ab8c7d :no_entry:
deploy-bot: console canary rollback complete, 100% traffic back to 9ab8c7c
deploy-bot: runtime and api continue in canary, will extend window by +10m to finish sanity checks
micah: good call. can you capture traces for the web pack builds and share?
deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood/deploys/rel-319/artifacts/webpack-logs.tar.gz
marina: downloading now, will scan for memory config flags
sre-oncall: metrics: no CPU spike, memory sustained on console nodes during build ~950MiB peak
anya: we should add NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=2048 in the next console image build
josh: create a follow-up ticket? I'll open one and tag infra + console-team
josh: ticket: RED-4721 https://redwood/issue/RED-4721 — include proposed NODE_OPTIONS change
deploy-bot: runtime canary complete, promoted to prod new revision runtime@v2.14.1
deploy-bot: api canary healthy, starting gradual rollout to 50%
deploy-bot: api rollout to 50% complete — no errors, latency stable
release-manager: patch notes: runtime perf improvement for kv-cache, api minor auth fix, console reverted to previous safe tag
marina: thanks y'all. I'll follow up with a dedicated console image build with larger heap
sre-oncall: closing monitoring window in 20m if no regressions
deploy-bot: deploy finished for runtime (v2.14.1) and api (v1.40.0). console remains on pinned tag 9ab8c7c
anya: excellent, thanks team. :tada:
release-manager: moving to post-release checklist and will schedule a short retro tomorrow
